items.source: Find all annotations of the specified annotation type that are present or meta-present on the root declaring class of this descriptor or on any interfaces that the root declaring class implements.
items.translation: 查找指定注解类型的所有注解，这些注解存在于该描述符的根声明类上或元存在于此，或者存在于根声明类实现的任何接口上。

items.source: Given the following example, if we are searching for the @Transactional annotation on the TransactionalTests class, then the properties of the AnnotationDescriptor would be as follows.
items.translation: 给定以下示例，如果我们在 TransactionalTests 类上搜索 @Transactional 注解，则 AnnotationDescriptor 的属性如下。

items.source: Given the following example, if we are searching for the @Transactional annotation on the UserRepositoryTests class, then the properties of the AnnotationDescriptor would be as follows.
items.translation: 给定以下示例，如果我们在 UserRepositoryTests 类上搜索 @Transactional 注解，则 AnnotationDescriptor 的属性如下。

items.source: If a corresponding annotation is found in the superclass hierarchy of the root declaring class, that will be returned. Otherwise, an attempt will be made to find a corresponding annotation in the enclosing class hierarchy of the root declaring class if appropriate.
items.translation: 如果在根声明类的超类层次结构中找到相应的注解，则返回该注解。否则，如果适当，将尝试在根声明类的封闭类层次结构中查找相应的注解。

items.source: If the annotation is used as a meta-annotation, the root declaring class is not directly annotated with the annotation but rather indirectly via a composed annotation.
items.translation: 如果注解用作元注解，根声明类 并非直接使用该注解进行标注，而是通过组合注解间接使用。

items.source: Find the next TestContextAnnotationUtils.AnnotationDescriptor for the specified annotation type in the hierarchy above the root declaring class of this descriptor.
items.translation: 查找指定注解类型在描述符的根声明类根声明类之上的层次结构中的下一个TestContextAnnotationUtils.AnnotationDescriptor。

items.source: Provide a textual representation of this AnnotationDescriptor.
Get the merged annotation for this descriptor.
items.translation: 获取此描述符的合并注解。

items.source: the next corresponding annotation descriptor if the annotation was found; otherwise null
items.translation: 如果找到该注解，则返回下一个对应的注解描述符；否则为 `null`。

items.source: toString in class Object
items.translation: `toString` 在类 `Object` 中

items.source: the set of all merged, synthesized Annotations found, or an empty set if none were found
items.translation: 所有合并、合成的 `Annotations` 的集合，如果未找到则返回空集。
